heading: Reaching people, one at a time
intro: Text them, or share the message to Messenger, Instagram, or wherever else you'd reach them. You send it. We just line people up.
introTextOnly: Each message opens in your own Messages app. You send it. We just line people up.
messagesNote: Send it in Messages, then come back and tap {action}.
copiedNote: Copied. Paste it wherever you reach them.
shareError: That didn't go through. You can try again.
